truth_boundary: Engineering sizing screen for CAD completeness. Not certification, FEA, dynamic contact simulation, or physical validation.

joint_and_linkage_assumptions.selected_rod_end_family_SRC: Aurora AM-M10T metric male PTFE-lined rod end
joint_and_linkage_assumptions.selected_lock_nut_family_SRC: DIN 985 / ISO 10511 prevailing torque lock nut

combined_climb_assumptions.local_drive_suspension_loop: Sub-millisecond motor/suspension command loop; preview sensors feed a predictive stair phase map and are not waited on at the stair edge.
combined_climb_assumptions.control_mode: Sensor-previewed predictive corner prepositioning plus sub-millisecond local wheel torque and suspension control; not wheel-only climbing.

smooth_climb_assumptions.preview_treads_reason: ifm O1D100 preview sensor (data/te_v059_sourced_part_register.json, id stair_preview_distance_sensor) has a 0.2-10 m measuring range, far beyond the 0.2794 m stair going; 2 treads of lookahead (0.559 m) stays well inside that range while giving a jerk-limited blend enough time budget instead of reacting at the stair edge.
